payload.title: Named Git branching strategies at kbs init
payload.description:
Not every team that uses Kanbus uses GitFlow; GitFlow is one specific branching strategy ("religion") among several. Today CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md ships as one fixed file with one workflow baked in.

Goal: at kbs init time the user can pick a named branching strategy, with GitFlow as the default and others supported (for example trunk-based development, GitHub Flow, GitLab Flow, release branching). The agent contributing instructions (CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md, and the branching guidance in AGENTS.md) are constructed from those init parameters instead of being a single fixed file.

Scope to explore:
- A catalog of named strategies, each defining its integration branch, release branch, where feature branches start and target, merge cadence, and where board-state commits land.
- kbs init options to choose a strategy and set its parameters (branch names such as develop and main), defaulting to GitFlow.
- Generating the contributing agent instructions from the chosen strategy, and regenerating them when the strategy changes.
- Strategy guidance for multiple agents working in parallel (worktrees, short-lived branches, frequent integration).

Origin: Ryan, 2026-10-02, after copying Chattic.us GitFlow rules into BotSpy by hand.
